lines.text: This bird can fly in reverse.
And the secret is hiding in its wings.
Hummingbirds fly forwards, backwards, sideways, even straight up and down.
Unlike other birds, they can truly hover in one spot.
Their wings can beat up to eighty times a second.
lines.caption: Their wings can beat up to 80 times a second.

lines.text: The secret? Each wing swivels at the shoulder and traces a figure eight.
lines.caption: The secret? Each wing swivels at the shoulder and traces a figure 8.

lines.text: Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
